key.name: start-crabs-bottom
key.description: Start crabs on the bottom of the cube.

key.name: school-similar-groups
key.description: Fish in different groups, but of the same type, swim together.

key.name: low-poly
key.description: Use less detailed models for increased performance.

key.name: creature-type
key.description: Type of sea creature.

key.name: creature-color
key.description: The color of the sea creature.

key.name: creature-number
key.description: The number of the sea creature.

key.name: creature-size
key.description: The size of the sea creature.

key.name: plant-type
key.description: Type of sea plant.

key.name: plant-color
key.description: The color of the sea plant.

key.name: plant-number
key.description: The number of the sea plants.

key.name: plant-size
key.description: The size of the sea plant.

key.name: show-water
key.description: Render water inside the cube.

key.name: show-water-wire
key.description: Render water wireframe inside the cube.

key.name: show-ground
key.description: Render ground inside the cube.

key.name: ground-color
key.description: Color of ground in the cube.

key.name: water-height
key.description: Height of water surface in the cube. (0.2 - 1)

key.name: water-color
key.description: Color of water in the cube.

key.name: grid-quality
key.description: Number of subdivisions that create a finer grid. (1 - 7)

key.name: render-waves
key.description: Render water waves inside the cube.

key.name: wave-ripple
key.description: Semi-randomize light scattering off water waves.

key.name: wave-amplitude
key.description: Amplitude of water waves. (0 - 0.5)

key.name: wave-frequency
key.description: Frequency of water waves. (0 - 100)

key.name: small-wave-amplitude
key.description: Amplitude of small water waves on the bigger ones. (0 - 0.5)

key.name: small-wave-frequency
key.description: Frequency of small water waves on the bigger ones. (0 - 100)

key.name: rescale-width
key.description: Rescale along the sides of the cube by the ratio of screen width to height.

key.name: rotate-lighting
key.description: Preserve light direction when rotating the cube.

key.name: light-inclination
key.description: The angle of light rays from the horizon in degrees (0 is from the viewer's perspective, 90 is from on top). Only has effect when Rotate Lighting is false. (0 - 180)

key.name: light-ambient
key.description: Component of light coming from all directions equally. (0.0 - 0.6)
